scenario_population: Author-written Spanish operational vignettes; not independent real-world evidence and not selected from hidden Modelica worlds.
task: I1 evidence classification and I2 structurally valid candidate hypothesis with cited facts; no unique-world identification claim.

architecture.instances: array of typed E1 AST objects
architecture.links: array of typed E1 AST edges

constraints.backend: E1 check_graph and render_model; no parameter re-fitting
constraints.observables: facts only; no numeric time series or true structure
constraints.score: strict schema+valid AST; evidence statuses per case vs author-coded rubric; anti-overclaim abstention
constraints.limitations: Small correlated author-written scenarios; gold is not independently blind, numerical mechanism/first order not identified; not a statistical superiority test.
